name: GHCN-Daily station list and inventory (AWS mirror)
publisher: NOAA, mirrored by the AWS Open Data Sponsorship Program
description: The two flat files that make GHCN-Daily usable: every station with its latitude, longitude, elevation and name; and an inventory giving, per station and per element, the first and last year of record. Together they let you pick a station by distance and by how long it has been measuring, instead of guessing an identifier.

access.etiquette: S3 public bucket, no credentials needed over HTTPS

fields: ghcnd-stations.txt: ID, LAT, LON, ELEV, STATE, NAME (fixed columns)
ghcnd-inventory.txt: ID, LAT, LON, ELEMENT, FIRSTYEAR, LASTYEAR

recipes.title: Nearest long-running stations to a point

gotchas.trap: Fixed-width, not delimited. Splitting on whitespace breaks on station names with spaces.
gotchas.fix: Slice by column position; the layout is documented in readme.txt beside the files.
